task.title: Install the Storage-Based Remediation Operator by using the CLI
task.shortdesc: You can use the OpenShift CLI (oc) to install the Storage-Based Remediation Operator.

ul.li: Log in as a user with cluster-admin privileges.

context.p: You can install the Storage-Based Remediation Operator in your own namespace or in the openshift-workload-availability namespace.

step.cmd: Create a Namespace custom resource (CR) for the Storage-Based Remediation Operator:

substep.cmd: Define the Namespace CR and save the YAML file, for example, workload-availability-namespace.yaml:

info.codeblock: apiVersion: v1 kind: Namespace metadata: name: openshift-workload-availability

substep.cmd: To create the Namespace CR, run the following command:
Define the OperatorGroup CR and save the YAML file, for example, workload-availability-operator-group.yaml:

info.codeblock: apiVersion: operators.coreos.com/v1 kind: OperatorGroup metadata: name: workload-availability-operator-group namespace: openshift-workload-availability

substep.cmd: To create the OperatorGroup CR, run the following command:
Define the Subscription CR and save the YAML file, for example, storage-based-remediation-subscription.yaml:

info.codeblock: apiVersion: operators.coreos.com/v1alpha1 kind: Subscription metadata: name: storage-based-remediation namespace: openshift-workload-availability spec: channel: stable installPlanApproval: Automatic name: storage-based-remediation source: redhat-operators sourceNamespace: openshift-marketplace

ul.li: namespace: Specify the Namespace where you want to install the Storage-Based Remediation Operator. To install the Storage-Based Remediation Operator in the openshift-workload-availability namespace, specify openshift-workload-availability in the Subscription CR.

installPlanApproval: Set the approval strategy to Manual in case your specified version is superseded by a later version in the catalog. This plan prevents an automatic upgrade to a later version and requires manual approval before the starting CSV can complete the installation.

step.cmd: Verify that you created the Storage-Based Remediation Operator StorageBasedRemediationTemplate CR:

ol.li: Verify that the installation succeeded by inspecting the CSV resource: $ oc get csv -n openshift-workload-availabilityNAME DISPLAY VERSION REPLACES PHASE storage-based-remediation.v0.3.0 Storage-Based Remediation Operator v.0.3.0 storage-based-remediation.v0.2.0 Succeeded

Verify that the Storage-Based Remediation Operator is up and running: $ oc get deployment -n openshift-workload-availabilityNAME READY UP-TO-DATE AVAILABLE AGE storage-based-remediation-controller-manager 1/1 1 1 28h
Verify that you created the StorageBasedRemediationConfig CR: $ oc get storagebasedremediationconfig -n openshift-workload-availabilityNAME AGE storage-based-remediation-config 28h

Verify that each storage-based remediation pod is scheduled and running on each worker node or control plane node: $ oc get daemonset -n openshift-workload-availabilityNAME DESIRED CURRENT READY UP-TO-DATE AVAILABLE NODE SELECTOR AGE storage-based-remediation-ds 6 6 6 6 6 <none> 28h
